Weedle

Bug Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Weedle is a Bug/Poison-type Hairy Bug Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3.2 kg. It evolves into Kakuna. Its highest base stat is Speed (50), with a base stat total of 195.
